status: Additional benchmark specified before new outcome computation
comparison: Same five-year domestic-redistribution cohort vs other verified domestic transition events in the same microdata subset; cohort next events are excluded from reference
matching: origin city, move year, recorded field at the move, observed career span bins0-4/5-9/10+ years, and last publication year at least arrival year+5
reference_population: other observed domestic moves, not necessarily never-international authors
primary_metrics: change in log1p1998-2011 domestic city strength
probability of moving to a city with larger early domestic strength
probability of destination having positive early domestic strength
secondary_hierarchy: independent research activity incidence mass in2005-2011, not deduplicated people or prestige
missing_support: Report supported record fraction; restrict both sides to strata with reference support; no imputation or outcome-selected countries
units: country summaries with minimum100 matched cohort records; sensitivity500; countries equal in cross-country summaries
inference: country median differences and bootstrap intervals; sign-test P values Holm adjusted across three primary benchmark contrasts; descriptive, not treatment effects
